weaknesses: The abstract could better clarify the specific contributions of the IRS approach compared to existing methods.
The experimental results section lacks a detailed comparison with other state-of-the-art certification methods, limiting the context for evaluating IRS's performance.
The paper does not sufficiently address potential limitations or scenarios where IRS may not perform as effectively.
strengths: The introduction of Incremental Randomized Smoothing (IRS) presents a novel approach to reducing the computational cost of robustness certification for modified neural networks.
The empirical results demonstrate significant speedups in certification time, providing strong evidence of the method's effectiveness.
The paper clearly articulates the theoretical foundations of IRS and provides a well-structured algorithmic framework.
